title: Old work orders with inactive parts still work, reopening keeps them inactive
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. A completed/invoiced work order that references a part now inactive.
custom_steps:
1. View, print and report on the completed/invoiced work order.
  2. Reopen it and check whether any inactive part on it became active.
  3. View a line whose part is now inactive and look for an inactive indication.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Completed and invoiced work orders that reference inactive parts stay viewable, printable and reportable; reopening a completed work order does not reactivate any inactive part on it.
  • Viewing a line whose part is now inactive shows an indication that the part is inactive.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 9 (Inactive parts cannot be selected); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
